name: Siding
description: Vinyl and fiber-cement lap siding with water-resistive barrier and fasteners, J-channel, corner posts, starter strip, vented soffit and fascia. Assemblies only: set your own rates.
author: CadCraft

sources.title: International Residential Code, Section R703 Exterior Covering (water-resistive barrier, siding attachment, anchored veneer ties)
Plain geometry: the quantity follows from the measured length, height or area and the stated module (no outside source needed)
The product data sheet of the coating, adhesive or product you specify (spread rate, coverage, coats)
International Residential Code, Section R806 Roof Ventilation

assume: Panels by the square (100 SF), 10% waste; double 4 in panels, 8 in per course.
Nails 16 in o.c. along each course (VSI manual): 1.5 courses per ft x 0.75 nails per ft = 1.125 per SF.
Water-resistive barrier over the whole wall (IRC R703.2), 10% for laps; cap fasteners about 1 per 2 SF (a starting figure: use the barrier maker’s schedule).
items.note: Measure each wall elevation; cut out openings over 4 SF (or lower the waste).
items.name: Vinyl siding, double 4 in, on water-resistive barrier

assume: Planks 8-1/4 in x 12 ft at 7 in exposure: 12 / 7 = 1.714 LF per SF, so one 12 ft plank per 7 SF; 10% waste.
One blind nail per stud crossing, studs 16 in o.c.: 1.714 x 0.75 = 1.29 per SF (the maker’s guide and IRC Table R703.3(1) give the fastening).
Water-resistive barrier over the whole wall (IRC R703.2), 10% for laps; cap fasteners about 1 per 2 SF (a starting figure: use the barrier maker’s schedule).
